{{Quote|Well, whaddya know? I ain't seen one of these since I was prospecting on Subterrel, beyond the Outer Rim!|Dexter Jettster|<ref name="AotC" />}}
'''Subterrel'''<ref name="AotC" /> was a [[planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|Melee and Ranged Weapons}}</ref> located in the [[Subterrel system]] in the [[Subterrel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Appendix" /> At some point before the [[Clone Wars]], [[Dexter Jettster]] spent [[time]] [[Prospector|prospecting]] on Subterrel.<ref name="AotC" /> There was an imperial campaign on Subterrel, which was used as an exemplar for high enemy casualties.<ref name="Star Wars Jedi:Survivor">''[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]''</ref>
